title: Walk-forward and out-of-sample testing
summary: Tune rules on one block of data, then test them unchanged on data they have not seen. Walk-forward testing repeats this step by step through time.
unreliableWhen: Once a rule is changed because of out-of-sample results, that data is in-sample. The test blocks are still the past and still a small sample.
goodExample: Tuning on periods 1–3, saving the plan version, and testing it unchanged on periods 4–6.
badExample: Looking at the out-of-sample results, tweaking the rules, and testing again on the same data.
